topics.titleEn: Turn Your Team Into a B2B Content Engine
topics.angle: guide + scale reach through employees, not just the brand page
topics.brief: Contrarian guide arguing personal profiles out-reach the brand page for B2B in 2026 (LinkedIn favors people and text posts over brand video). Sections: why employee advocacy beats corporate posting; making it voluntary and authentic, not scripted; a lightweight content-supply system (prompts, swipe files, review, not mandates); measuring reach and pipeline without vanity metrics; tools and pitfalls (over-automation, compliance, burnout). Verify LinkedIn engagement claims (e.g. the text-post and video-growth stats) against a cited 2026 social report. Sources: a 2026 social-media trends report; a B2B employee-advocacy case study. Distinct from 'Personal Brand on X for Founders' (individual) and 'Build Community' posts. End with a 30-day advocacy rollout plan.

topics.titleEn: What to Post When You Have Zero Audience
topics.keywordEn: how to start social media from scratch
topics.angle: how-to + the cold-start content plan for a new account
topics.brief: Question-driven cold-start guide for the first 90 days of a brand-new account. Sections: why algorithms still surface good content without followers (interest signals over follower count); picking one platform and one narrow angle; a starter content menu (proof, teardown, how-to, hot take, behind-the-scenes); posting cadence you can sustain; using early replies/DMs to seed distribution; reading the first signals and iterating. Verify platform reach-for-new-accounts claims against a cited source; keep tactics evergreen across networks. Sources: a 2026 social trends report; a documented zero-to-audience case study. Distinct from 'Build Community, Not Followers' (philosophy) — this is specifically what to post. End with a first-2-weeks content calendar.

topics.titleTr: Gemini Omni 1.1: Google'ın Yeni Video Modeli
topics.titleEn: Gemini Omni 1.1: Google's New Video Model
topics.angle: deep-dive + what the multimodal video model does and costs
topics.brief: Story-led explainer on Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, Google's Aug 2026 multimodal model tuned for fast video, image and text, with audio+video editing and 360p/720p/1080p/4K output (1080p and 4K via upscaling). Sections: what it is and how it differs from prior Veo/Imagen work; the resolution-control and editing features; realistic use cases (social clips, product shots) and current limits; access, pricing and where it runs; how it sits against Sora and rivals. Verify model name, resolution/upscaling details and availability against Google's release notes; don't overstate quality. Sources: Google Gemini release notes; a hands-on writeup. Distinct from the 'Sora vs Veo' comparison — this is a single-model deep-dive. End with who should try it now.

topics.titleEn: Claude Scheduled Tasks: Automate Recurring Work
topics.angle: how-to + set up reliable recurring agent runs
topics.brief: Field-notes how-to on running recurring work with Claude's scheduled tasks (in Cowork/Claude Code environments). Sections: what a scheduled task is and where it fires; designing a good recurring prompt (idempotent, self-contained, clear success criteria); notifications so results reach you when you're away; guardrails (scope, permissions, cost) for autonomous runs; when to prefer a scheduled agent over a Zapier/Make flow; debugging silent failures. Verify the current scheduling, notification and permission model against Anthropic docs before publishing. Sources: Anthropic Claude Code/Cowork scheduling docs; a practitioner writeup. Distinct from the 'ChatGPT Pulse is gone: Scheduled Tasks' post (OpenAI). End with a template for a weekly digest task.

topics.titleTr: RAG mı Uzun Bağlam mı: 2026'da Hangisi?
topics.titleEn: RAG vs Long Context: Which Do You Need in 2026?
topics.angle: comparison + when to retrieve vs when to stuff the window
topics.brief: Contrarian comparison: with 1M-token windows common, do you still need RAG? Sections: the case for long context (simplicity, fewer moving parts) vs its costs (latency, token spend, lost-in-the-middle recall); where retrieval still wins (freshness, citations, huge or private corpora, cost control); hybrid patterns (retrieve-then-fill-context, caching); a decision framework by corpus size, update rate and budget. Verify recall-degradation and pricing claims against cited benchmarks and current model docs; keep numbers dated. Sources: a long-context vs RAG benchmark/analysis; model pricing pages. Distinct from 'Fine-Tuning vs RAG' and '1M-Token Context: What Changes' — this pits RAG directly against long context. End with a chooser and a cost-per-query worksheet.

topics.titleTr: AI Ajanları Prodüksiyon Öncesi Nasıl Test Edilir
topics.titleEn: How to Test AI Agents Before Production
topics.angle: how-to + build a test harness for agent behavior
topics.brief: Field-notes how-to on testing AI agents before they ship. Sections: why unit tests aren't enough (non-determinism, tool calls, multi-step trajectories); building fixtures and simulated tools/environments; trajectory and tool-call assertions vs final-answer checks; regression suites and golden transcripts; LLM-as-judge with human spot-checks; adversarial and jailbreak/prompt-injection cases; CI gating and cost budgets. Verify recommended techniques against a cited agent-evaluation guide; distinguish from plain output evals. Sources: an agent-evaluation/testing guide; an eval-framework's docs. Distinct from 'How to Evaluate LLM Outputs with Evals' (output-level) and the multi-agent-orchestration post. End with a starter agent-test checklist and a CI gate example.

topics.titleEn: Kubernetes Gateway API: Beyond Ingress in 2026
topics.angle: guide + migrate from Ingress to the Gateway API
topics.brief: Data-led guide to the Kubernetes Gateway API as the modern replacement for Ingress. Sections: why Ingress hit its limits (annotation sprawl, weak multi-team model); the Gateway API resource model (GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute, role separation for platform vs app teams); traffic splitting, header routing and cross-namespace refs; implementations (Envoy Gateway, Istio, NGINX Gateway Fabric, cloud controllers); a phased Ingress-to-Gateway migration; where it ties into service mesh. Verify the API's current GA status, version and feature support against the Kubernetes/Gateway API docs. Sources: Kubernetes Gateway API docs; an implementation's migration guide. Distinct from the service-mesh and Helm/Kustomize posts. End with a migration checklist.

topics.titleTr: CSS Anchor Positioning: JS'siz Popover ve İpucu
topics.titleEn: CSS Anchor Positioning: Popovers Without JS
topics.angle: how-to + build tooltips and menus with native anchoring
topics.brief: Story-led how-to on CSS Anchor Positioning for tooltips, popovers and menus without a JS positioning library. Sections: the problem it kills (Popper/Floating-UI boilerplate, z-index and overflow fights); anchor-name and position-anchor basics; position-area and the @position-try fallback for viewport collisions; pairing with the Popover API and dialog; progressive enhancement and current browser support with fallbacks. Verify property syntax, @position-try behavior and up-to-date browser support against MDN and caniuse before publishing; give a graceful degradation path. Sources: MDN CSS anchor positioning docs; a caniuse support table. Distinct from the :has()/nesting, container-queries and View-Transitions posts. End with a copy-paste tooltip and dropdown recipe.
